# Copilot instructions

Use the harness to gather evidence first, then draft artifacts in the configured artifact output location.

- Keep observed behavior, inferred intent, candidate requirements, approved requirements, target design decisions, and open questions distinct.
- Treat `search_repository` results as lexical candidates until a `read_source_excerpt` result confirms the source text directly.
- A requirement is not approved unless the department explicitly marks it approved.
- If Toolkit files are not configured, mark Toolkit conformance as pending.
- Never request writes inside the legacy repository roots.
